title: Coefficient estimates and Hankel determinant for the class of leaf shaped starlike function
summary: In this paper, we study a Ma--Minda type subclass of starlike functions associated with the normalized arcsine function $\varphi(z)=1+\frac{2}π\arcsin z.$ Using the Carathéodory function approach together with sharp coefficient estimates for Schwarz functions, we obtain explicit sharp bounds for the initial Taylor coefficients and logarithmic coefficients of functions in this class.
